title: Type 6 (unDrv) followed by Type 7 (identDrv) in one trip
description: An unidentified event (Type 6, unDrv, driver null) arrives first, then an identified event (Type 7, identDrv) for driver A arrives 60 seconds later, both while the trip is open. Must prove: the unDrv row persists with contact_id null, is not linked while the trip is open, and is never considered for the claim; the identDrv row wins the claim outright and both assignees become A. Must NOT change: the unDrv event must never itself set an assignee, and must not block A's identification from winning.
